name: Paper Diagram
tagline: Warm beige paper with dot grid, thick-outlined white diagram cards with hard shadows, vermilion and blue arrows.

palette.description: Warm paper beige with ink text and red and blue paired accents.

typography.style: Heavy sans titles over plain sans labels; replaces the original Chinese font.

best_for: Explainer decks that compare two forces or ideas with simple diagrams and outlined cards. Gives a sketchbook feel to technical concepts.
navigation: inline keyboard handler (ArrowRight/Space, click, touch); step reveals are shown on slide entry
